entities.summary: Dinah Jane Milika Ilaisaane Hansen is an American singer.In 2012, she auditioned for the second season of The X Factor and later became a member of Fifth Harmony, which went on to become one of the best-selling girl groups of all time. After the group's hiatus announcement in 2018, Jane began working as a solo artist.
